style: Style: warm, polished flat vector illustration with soft gradients and subtle paper grain, like a premium Taiwanese education promo animation. Palette: cream/ivory background, deep navy blue, crimson red, and shining gold accents (gold laurel leaves, thin glowing gold circuit lines). 16:9 landscape, 1920x1080 composition, cinematic depth with clear foreground / midground / background layers. The illustration should fill the whole frame edge to edge; leave only a soft, less busy band in the lower 20% for subtitles (still illustrated, not a blank panel). ABSOLUTELY NO text, letters, numbers, words, logos or signage anywhere in the image. People are friendly stylized cartoon characters (Taiwanese teachers and students) with simple cute faces: dot eyes and gentle smiles. This is Chiayi City, Taiwan: low-rise townscape only, NO skyscrapers, NO Taipei 101.

scenes.s01: Dawn over Chiayi City, Taiwan: a gentle skyline of low-rise city buildings, a round traffic fountain plaza in the center, Alishan mountains with a sea of clouds far behind. Golden sunrise light rays rise from the horizon. Floating in the sky: a glowing tablet with a soft blue AI chip symbol (no letters) and an open book releasing tiny sparkles. Gold circuit lines trail across the sky like ribbons.
scenes.s03: A large shining gold trophy cup at the center on a navy pedestal, surrounded by a gold laurel wreath. Around it in a gentle arc float five round award medallion badges of different designs (crown, star, ribbon, flower, shield) without any text. Red and navy ribbons swirl, gold confetti sparkles, cream background with soft radial glow.
